mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (user_id, story_id, content, parent_id, status) VALUES (#{userId},#{storyId},#{content},#{parentId},1)
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id,c.user_id,c.story_id,c.content,c.parent_id,c.status,c.create_time,u.nickname,u.avatar_url FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON c.user_id=u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id=#{commentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE story_id=#{storyId} AND status=1
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status=0 WHERE comment_id=#{commentId}
